topic: Day 73 — reel — A habit you're proud of isn't always a habit that actually works
text:
Some habits
are [impressive]
and do nothing.
caption:
A routine can look excellent from outside and produce no result you actually wanted. Check the outcome, not the aesthetic.

Follow for one of these a day.
